conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello? I applied for a personal loan last month, but nobody’s told me what’s happening with it.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Good afternoon, Sir. I’d be happy to check the status. Could you provide your application ID or full name?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: It’s Priyansh Sharma. I don’t have any ID number… nobody gave me one!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: No worries, I can search by name. One moment—

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: And please, don’t put me on hold for ages! I’ve been waiting too long already.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Of course, Sir. I’ll be as quick as possible. It looks like your application is under review due to a pending CIBIL score update—

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: CIBIL? What’s that? Nobody told me about this! Why is it taking so long?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I apologize for the confusion. CIBIL is your credit score, and we’re waiting for the latest report—

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: But I need the loan urgently! Can’t you speed it up?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Absolutely, I understand the urgency. I’ll escalate this to expedite the process and keep you updated.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Please do. I really hope I hear back soon this time.
